chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Say: O Allah, I ask You from every goodness of which Your Knowledge is encompassing, and I seek Refuge with You from every evil of which Your Knowledge is encompassing. O Allah, I ask You for Your well-being in all my affairs, and I seek Refuge with You from the disgrace of the world and the punishment of the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What is the comprehensive supplication for seeking all goodness and refuge from all evil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication from Imam al-Baqir (AS) encapsulates the Shia tradition of comprehensive du'a by linking divine omniscience ('ahata bihi 'ilmuhu) to the believer's specific needs for 'afiyah (well-being) and protection from dunya's disgrace. It serves as a concise yet profound model for integrating worldly stability with spiritual salvation, reflecting the Imams' emphasis on holistic divine care.
